notes:
{至|いた}る is a formal/literary verb meaning to reach a point or result in an outcome. It is far more common in written Japanese, news, and formal speech than in casual conversation.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: ⟦{自動詞|じどうし}→自動詞：10977_jidoushi⟧ (intransitive)
- Takes the particle ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: 〜⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{至|いた}る

ASPECT (ている):
{至|いた}って⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧ indicates a state has been reached and continues: ⟦{現在|げんざい}→現在：01556_genzai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{至|いた}って⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧ (it continues to the present).

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- 〜⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{至|いた}る: to reach, to arrive at (a conclusion, agreement, result)
- 〜⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{至|いた}る⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧: up to, until, as far as
- {至|いた}る⟦{所|ところ}→所：01137_tokoro⟧: everywhere (set expression, often written {至|いた}る{所|ところ})
- 〜⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{至|いた}った⟦{経緯|けいい}→経緯：02782_keii⟧: the circumstances that led to ~

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {至|いた}る: formal/literary; abstract destinations (conclusions, results)
- ⟦{着|つ}く→着く：00680_tsuku⟧: everyday; physical arrival
- ⟦{届|とど}く→届く：00899_todoku⟧: everyday; something reaching or being delivered
- ⟦{達|たっ}する→達する：02129_tassuru⟧: formal; reaching a level or target (e.g. ⟦{目標|もくひょう}→目標：03631_mokuhyou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{達|たっ}する→達する：02129_tassuru⟧)
